tasks.notes: Deleted src/menu.ts and test/menu.test.ts. No remaining imports found in src/ or test/ (plan.test.ts only had a comment mentioning 'menu loops', not an import). All 591 tests pass.

tasks.title: Verify build and full test suite
tasks.description:
Final verification task. Run the full test suite and build to ensure everything works after all refactoring.

1. Run `bun test` — all tests must pass
2. Run `bun run build` — must compile without errors
3. Run `./dist/ralph plan --help` — smoke test that the command still registers
4. Verify `commands/generate-tasks.md` and `commands/review-tasks.md` exist and are well-formed
5. If any issues found, fix them

The `commands/` directory is static markdown — it doesn't need to be compiled, just needs to be findable at runtime via `resolveRalphRoot()`.
